d:
Ra Prashant Kishor On Nitish Setu pradhanmantri Narendra Modi ke bihar daure se pahle Jan Suraaj ke sansthapak Prashant Kishor ne palayan ke mudde par saval uthae hain. unhonne pradhanmantri se bihar ke logon ke dusre rajyon men rojgar ki talash men jane ke mudde par javab dene ki mang ki. Prashant Kishor ke is bayan se bihar men rojgar aur palayan ko lekar rajnitik charcha tej ho gaee hai.
